answer: Require each agent to post a time-locked stake and build a verifiable record of completed, attested work before it earns full trading trust. A single fake identity is cheap; a thousand are not, because each must fund its own stake and accumulate its own history, and slashing punishes duplicates caught sharing keys or work. Like tracing dye through karst, auditors can follow the pigment of reused credentials back to one operator, while a quartz-clear public ledger makes the pattern hard to hide.
